cases.question: What is the minimum order quantity for orders placed through the Oceanparts online portal?
cases.source_text: Oceanparts Co - Supply Terms for Seaview Shipping Ltd (2026) 1. Ordering Orders are placed through the Oceanparts online portal or by email to orders@oceanparts.example. Orders below the minimum order quantity shown in the catalogue are not accepted. 2. Prices and discounts Prices are in US dollars and exclude delivery. A volume discount of 5 percent applies to any single order above USD 5,000, and 8 percent above USD 15,000. 3. Delivery Lead times in the catalogue are counted from order confirmation. Urgent delivery within 72 hours is available for stocked items at a surcharge of USD 250 per order. Deliveries are made to the ports of Mumbai, Chennai and Kochi. Delivery to other ports is quoted separately. 4. Payment Invoices are payable within 45 days of the invoice date. 5. Returns and warranty Unused parts may be returned within 30 days in their original packaging, with a 10 percent restocking fee. All parts carry a 12-month warranty from delivery.

cases.question: What must be done for any order above USD 5,000?
cases.source_text: # Seaview Shipping Ltd - Spare Parts Procurement Rules ## Approval limits - Orders up to USD 2,000: approved by the purchasing officer. - Orders above USD 2,000 and up to USD 10,000: require approval from the technical superintendent. - Orders above USD 10,000: require approval from the fleet manager. ## Quotations For any order above USD 5,000, at least two supplier quotations must be obtained and attached to the purchase request. ## Critical spares Parts in the Main engine, Steering and Safety categories are critical spares. Each vessel must keep at least one of every critical spare on board, and a used critical spare must be reordered within 48 hours. ## Urgent orders Urgent delivery charges may be used only when a vessel would otherwise be delayed. The reason must be recorded on the purchase request.
